## Problem

What are you trying to do, and what stops you today? Describe the situation rather than the
solution.

## Proposal

What you would like AgentScope to do. If it changes a contract (dataset format, API schema,
check semantics, CLI exit codes), say which.

## Alternatives considered

Other ways to solve the problem, including what you do today.

## Scope and constraints

AgentScope is a local, single-user tool whose verdicts are deterministic. Please note whether
the proposal:

- sends data off the machine or adds a network destination;
- affects what is stored (see PRIVACY.md) or the security model (see SECURITY.md);
- affects determinism, baselines or gate results;
- needs a new dependency.
